notes: Imported from data/raw/owid/owid_energy.csv, column "electricity_demand_per_capita_kwh", years 1990 on (one row per country and year; the latest year with a value is shown, the full series is kept for charts and derived datasets).

Codebook (data/raw/owid/owid_energy.codebook.csv) title: "Total electricity demand per person"; unit: "kilowatt-hours (kWh)"; sources: Ember – Yearly Electricity Data Europe (2026); Ember – Yearly Electricity Data (2026); Population based on various sources (2024).

Rows with a blank iso_code are matched by their "country" name: Kosovo -> XKX; regions, income groups and source-defined aggregates (e.g. "Europe (EI)", "G20 (Ember)", "World") and former states are skipped. A blank cell is kept as missing, never 0.
caveats: Computed by Our World in Data as Ember demand ÷ OWID population.

scoring.rationale: Context: describes the electricity system, not dependence on its own; used as an input or shown next to the scored import exposure.
